title: Marco Rubio to visit Indian billionaire Ambani's refinery in Gujarat as U.S. diesel prices surge
summary_full: Not only is Ambani's Reliance investing in a U.S. refinery and buying Venezuelan oil, but its strong ability to supply diesel has put Jamnagar on the map during Rubio's visit.
